scope_semantics: Scopes describe intended environment applicability within target_service; they do not assert variables already exist or must be added to all Vercel scopes. CI/localtool settings are not Vercel app settings.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

variables.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY

variables.name: APP_ENV

public_prefix_audit.rule: Every VITE_* and NEXT_PUBLIC_* value can reach the browser; never use these prefixes for provider credentials, session encryption, webhook tokens or management secrets.

service_gaps.configuration_method: CLI arguments --database, --port, --web-origin; no os.environ/getenv consumer in the local gateway
service_gaps.gap: Static Vercel deployment does not deploy the long-running Python/SQLite gateway. Local Vite proxy is development/preview-server config, not a production Vercel backend. No invented VITE_API_URL or empty provider key resolves this.
Model/chat, calendar, mail, payments and production media adapters need separately implemented provider contracts. Do not invent environment names or expose future credentials to the static site.

provider_separation.Auth0: Six names verified present by metadata in all three scopes; untouched and not activated/deactivated by this audit. No reviewed active app consumer; historical Needs Attention not resolved by metadata presence.
provider_separation.Clerk: Vite UI consumes the two public settings. Parent verified both expected public settings via boolean API readbacks, including explicit disabled activation. Existing Next publishable key and server secret metadata exist in all scopes; secret value/mode/live pairing not verified.

evidence.source_ref_semantics: Named source_refs bind declarations and consumer callsites. Dynamic consumers may reference configuration objects instead of repeating the literal variable name. Auth0 refs establish reviewed application boundaries, not an existing Auth0 consumer.
